claim_cap: a development evidence-integrity audit of the M0-C IForest and PCA event-F1 negatives.  It decides whether those negatives are a threshold artefact or data harm.  It is not a headroom probe, does not retune contamination, and never enters a Yahoo capability claim

held_fixed.acting_bytes: the training substrate only; Query bytes raw
held_fixed.primary_metric: pointwise AUPRC on development_exposed_eval, existing aegists_iforest_v1.auprc, no new threshold
held_fixed.companion_metric: event F1 from the same score_series call; not a judgment input

c_a_iforest.score: -decision_function; ranking-identical to score_samples; no threshold in AUPRC

spec.detector: sliding-window IsolationForest, one model per series
spec.standardization: scalar mean/std from P(B) only, applied unchanged to the untouched Query; std == 0 is replaced by 1
spec.query_rule: decision_function(window) < 0, the threshold frozen at fit time by contamination; never refitted on the Query
spec.event_rule: consecutive anomalous points merge into one predicted event
spec.matching: greedy one-to-one by row overlap against NAB windows; a window is the set of rows whose timestamp falls inside it
spec.primary_metric: macro average of per-series event F1
spec.borrowed_from: a-evolve/AegisTS/Error_Detection/detectors/models/IForest.py -- window+IsolationForest structure only; not its model-selection stack, and not its train/predict normalization asymmetry

c_c_pca.score: window RMS residual mapped to the window-ending point by the existing score_region alignment

spec.family_claim_cap: readings taken with this Consumer speak for the deterministic low-rank reconstruction family only; they do not extrapolate to autoencoders, TimesNet or any learned/iterative reconstruction model
spec.detector: sliding-window low-rank projection, one model per series
spec.standardization: scalar mean/std from the training substrate only, applied unchanged to the untouched Query; std == 0 is replaced by 1 -- the same function the in-service IForest Consumer uses
spec.centering: 20-vector column mean of the training window matrix
spec.decomposition: numpy.linalg.svd, the exact LAPACK factorisation; no randomized SVD, no truncated iterative solver, no power iteration, no seed
spec.rank_basis: a column-centered 20-point window of a locally smooth or quasi-periodic series is spanned by a level/slope-residual mode plus one periodic pair; rank 3 is the smallest rank carrying that family.  Fixture-gated at explained-variance ratio >= 0.90 on a clean synthetic substrate, then frozen -- never scanned on Yahoo
spec.score: root-mean-square reconstruction residual; higher = more anomalous
spec.threshold: the 0.90 quantile of the training substrate's residual distribution, frozen at fit time; never refitted on the Query
spec.threshold_basis: parity with the in-service IForest Consumer's contamination = 0.1: both Consumers carry the same 10% frozen training-time alarm budget, so a delta between them is not an alarm-rate artefact
spec.query_rule: residual > frozen threshold; the Query bytes are never written
spec.scoring_layer: merge_events / match_events / event_f1 / auprc / background_alarm_rate imported from consumers.aegists_iforest_v1 -- not re-implemented, so all three M0-C Consumers score identically
spec.primary_metric: macro average of per-series event F1

c_b_supervised.reason: mechanism is positive-row erosion, independently measured and already threshold-free

true_held_out: remaining 41 sealed series; unread this book

c_a_iforest.why: no prior AUPRC identity reading exists for this roster / split / Consumer; this number is the first anchor, not a reproduction of a landed artefact

c_c_pca.why: no prior AUPRC identity reading exists for this roster / split / Consumer; this number is the first anchor, not a reproduction of a landed artefact

m0c_f1_reproduction.note: event-F1 companion, not a judgment input; confirms the same fits and the same score_series path as M0-C

c_a_iforest.reason: at least one program has AUPRC macro Δ ≤ −0.005 and harmed series > 2/24

c_c_pca.reason: some programs sit in the artefact band, some meet the DATA_HARM bar; labelled per program

c_a_iforest.not_a_judgment: sign agreement is reported because the book asks for it; it does not open or close a verdict

c_c_pca.not_a_judgment: sign agreement is reported because the book asks for it; it does not open or close a verdict

two_run.note: two complete 24 x 5 x 2 exams in one process; the official cap (280) is charged only to the first exam; the second is a verification replay and is reported separately

outside_findings.reading: IForest AUPRC uses the existing -decision_function ranking.  That ranking is identical to -score_samples because decision_function = score_samples - offset_ is a per-model constant shift.  No new threshold was introduced to break the tie.
PCA maps the window residual to the window-ending point via the existing score_region alignment; this book does not invent a second mapping.

event-F1 still uses each Consumer's in-service threshold (IForest decision < 0; PCA residual > training 0.90 quantile).  That is the old-calibre companion, taken from the same fit, and is not an input to the verdict.
aegists_iforest_v1.FOREST_KWARGS['contamination'] remains 0.1.  This audit does not retune a Consumer in service.
